newsitem.title: ITALY: Ciampi sees room for BTP-Bund spread to fall.
newsitem.headline: Ciampi sees room for BTP-Bund spread to fall.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said he saw no reason for Italy to have a BTP-Bund yield spread greater than 60-70 basis points.

"There is still space to reduce (the BTP-Bund spread). I don't see why, if our credibility increases, we must have a differential greater than 60 to 70 basis points like the one enjoyed by Spain," Ciampi said in an interview with financial daily Il Sole.
The spread between the February 2007 Btp and the July 4 2007 Bund is currently 132 basis points.
